<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="10"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="18WUUMmHpgup5d4w8E0x"> <mxGraphModel dx="934" dy="643" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%% Outbox backlog recovery: detect -> triage -> retry -> DLQ/manual replay
%% See docs/flows/outbox-backlog-recovery.md for the full explanation.
flowchart TD
	A[\"Signal: auth_outbox_backlog rising,\nauth_outbox_publish_attempts_total{result=failed} > 0,\nor auth_outbox_publish_lag_seconds elevated\"] --> B[Detect]
	B --> C[\"Query outbox_event GROUP BY status\n(FAILED rows are invisible to the backlog gauge)\"]
	C --> D{Row status?}

	D -->|\"PUBLISHING, claim_until < now\"| E[\"Self-heals automatically:\nreclaimStalePublishing() -> status=NEW\"]
	E --> R

	D -->|\"NEW, next_attempt_at in future\"| F[\"Waiting on backoff schedule\nNo action needed\"]

	D -->|\"NEW, next_attempt_at far in past\"| G[\"Scheduler not polling,\nor batch size too small\n-> investigate OutboxScheduler health\"]

	D -->|\"FAILED, retry_count >= 5\"| T[Triage]

	T --> H{\"Root cause of last_error?\"}
	H -->|\"Transient infra\n(Kafka outage, network blip)\"| I[\"Confirm Kafka / infra healthy again\"]
	H -->|\"Bad data / non-retryable payload\"| J[\"Requires code or data fix first\"]

	I --> K[\"Manual replay:\nUPDATE outbox_event\nSET status=NEW, retry_count=0,\nnext_attempt_at=now, last_error=null\nWHERE event_id=:eventId AND status=FAILED\"]
	J -->|\"Fixed\"| K
	J -->|\"Not fixed\"| L[\"Leave FAILED for audit/escalation\n(no automatic requeue exists today)\"]

	K --> R[\"Scheduler resumes normal\nclaim -> publish -> retry loop\"]
	R --> M{Published?}
	M -->|Yes| N[\"status=PUBLISHED\nbacklog gauge decreases\"]
	M -->|\"No, exhausts retries again\"| T

",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
